Name: Skull Cavern Time Fix For Multiplayer
Author: Sisko0
Description:
[size=6][b]Skull Cavern Time Fix for Multiplayer[/b][/size]

Fixes the Skull Cavern time slowdown mechanic in multiplayer when using a headless host bot.

[b][size=5]The Problem[/size][/b]

In vanilla multiplayer Stardew Valley, time only slows down in Skull Cavern when [b]ALL[/b] players are inside it. When running a dedicated server with a host bot (like "Always On Server" mod), this breaks because the host bot never enters the cavern.

[size=5][b]The Solution[/b][/size]

This mod completely ignores the host bot and applies proportional time slowdown based on real players only:

Formula:[b]

[/b] [code]2000ms × (real players in SC / total real players)[/code]

[size=4][b]Examples[/b][/size]

[b]Solo play with host bot:[/b]
- You in cavern = 100% slowdown (2000ms)
- You outside = 0% slowdown

[b]You + partner with host bot:[/b]
- Both in cavern = 100% slowdown (2000ms)
- One in cavern = 50% slowdown (1000ms)
- Neither in cavern = 0% slowdown

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]

1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0+
2. Extract mod folder to [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b]
3. Launch game through SMAPI

[b]For Docker/headless servers:[/b] See the [url=https://github.com/ZeynelKoca/stardew-skull-cavern-multiplayer]Source Code[/url] for Docker integration guide.

[b][size=4]Configuration[/size][/b]

Auto-generated [b]config.json[/b]:

[code]{
  "Enabled": true,
  "VerboseLogging": false
}[/code]
Enable VerboseLogging to see detailed time adjustment messages in SMAPI console.
[b]
Requirements
[/b]
- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI 4.0.0+
- Multiplayer mode (mod only works on the host/server)

[b]Compatibility[/b]

Should work with all mods including Always On Server, Auto Load Game, TimeSpeed, etc.
